nodes.label: Pod Security Hardening Pattern
nodes.rationale: All app/ai-tier Deployments (frontend, judge0, notification, ollama, proctoring, student) share an identical hardening template: pod-level runAsNonRoot/runAsUser 1000/fsGroup 1000, container-level allowPrivilegeEscalation:false with capabilities.drop:[ALL] and a configurable readOnlyRootFilesystem, an emptyDir tmp-dir mount to support the read-only root filesystem, and preferred podAntiAffinity keyed on app.kubernetes.io/name to spread replicas across nodes for availability. This is a deliberate least-privilege + high-availability convention applied uniformly across services rather than an incidental duplication.
